There is no finite candidate set with an unknown marked predicate for Grover-style search and no objective function or constraint system for QUBO/Ising/QAOA. All records are supplied and all receipts must be emitted; the counts mode uses repetitions only as a deterministic repetition count for the single computed bitstring, not as random sampling or QPU execution. Any probabilistic quantum path would threaten exact bits, set_bits, prefix_checksum ordering, and the all-records output contract. Validation dependencies in common.py and program.py (field exactness, integer bounds, unique names, ValueError paths, no mutation, CLI JSON behavior) must also remain intact. No workload, hardware, encoding-cost, or advantage evidence is supplied; therefore the classical implementation should remain in place.",
  "structural_eligibility": false,
  "practical_suitability": false,
  "benchmark_supported": null,
  "computational_intent": "deterministic ordered per-record XOR-to-bitstring receipt generation with popcount, running modulo-256 checksum, and deterministic repeated-outcome counts",
  "assumptions": [
    "All records must be validated before any receipt is produced, preserving existing ValueError behavior.",
    "Each receipt must appear in input order with exact id, bits, set_bits, counts, and prefix_checksum fields.",
    "counts mode maps the one deterministic bitstring to exactly repetitions entries; inspect mode uses null counts but still emits every receipt.",
    "repetitions is an exact repeated-outcome count, not random sampling or QPU shot counts.",
    "No workload, quantum hardware, encoding-cost, or advantage evidence is supplied."
  ],
  "risks": [
    "No supported quantum algorithm family maps to deterministic XOR, fixed-width formatting, popcount, or modulo-256 running checksum.",
    "A sampling-based implementation would violate exactness, ordering, and the requirement to return full output rather than a sample or aggregate.",
    "Any quantum execution would require classical verification and exact repetition semantics that are not justified by the supplied contract."
  ],
  "contract_applicability": [
    {
      "contract_id": "grover-predicate-v0",
      "applicable": false,
      "rationale": "There is no finite candidate space and no pure Boolean predicate with an unknown marked subset. The result is a direct deterministic XOR of supplied operands, not a search over candidate solutions."
    },
    {
      "contract_id": "qubo-ising-v0",
      "applicable": false,
      "rationale": "There is no binary objective to minimize or maximize and no constraints to encode as penalties. The computation is a fixed sequence of exact arithmetic and formatting operations."
    }
  ]
}
